label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The export button stays greyed out after a failed export because the busy state is set to true before the export starts but is only set back to false in the success path of the exportReport promise. If the export fails and throws an error, the busy state never resets, leaving the button disabled indefinitely. To fix this, the busy state should be reset to false in both the success and failure paths of the exportReport call, ensuring the button is re-enabled even after an error.
